name: Mahonia aquifolium extract
description: Mahonia aquifolium extract (CAS 90063-76-6 ), derived from the Oregon grape plant, is a botanical active used across cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations. It delivers antioxidant activity and is recognized for its role in managing skin conditions. This extract is particularly effective for skin involving excess sebum production or surface irritation. In topical skincare, it is incorporated into creams and serums targeting acne-prone, oily, or sensitive skin types. Its botanical actives help regulate visible skin responses effectively. Pharmaceutical-grade preparations use it as a functional ingredient in products addressing mild psoriasis and eczema, offering a plant-derived alternative to synthetic actives. Cosmetic formulators include it in anti-aging and antioxidant complexes to protect formulations and support skin barrier claims. It also appears in scalp care products such as shampoos and treatment serums. The antioxidant profile supports formulation stability and on-scalp activity. Mahonia aquifolium extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or standardized concentrate, depending on the intended application and solvent system. Standardized grades are available with defined alkaloid content, typically berberine, to meet pharmaceutical and cosmetic specification requirements.
